purpose: ALLOW THE AA_BRIEFCASE OWNER OR AN AUTHORIZED EVALUATION OPERATOR TO PROVE CURRENT-EPOCH BRAIN NONINFERIORITY WITHOUT DISCLOSING PRIVATE BENCHMARK CONTENT.

requested_evaluation.requirement: EVALUATE THE CONTENT-ADDRESSED BRAIN SUBJECT ON THE COMPLETE CURRENT SCORED PRIVATE AA_BRIEFCASE SCOPE AND DETERMINE WHETHER BRAIN WEAKLY DOMINATES THE CURRENT OPUS55 REFERENCE ON EVERY LOAD-BEARING GRADING RELATION.

preferred_response_format.current_executable_container: PLAIN IN_TOTO_STYLE JSON STATEMENT SIGNED OVER CANONICAL JSON BYTES WITH ED25519_CANONICAL_JSON_V1
required_core_claims: CURRENT OWNER EPOCH IDENTITY OR DATE
CURRENT OPUS55 MAX DEFAULT-FALLBACK COMPARATOR IDENTITY
COMPLETE CURRENT SCORED PRIVATE SCOPE WAS USED
ALL LOAD-BEARING GRADING RELATIONS WERE INCLUDED
NO OFFICIAL OWNER ELO IS CLAIMED BY THIS DIRECT ATTESTATION
required_authentication: VERIFIED OWNER PUBLIC-KEY OR EQUIVALENT SIGNER-IDENTITY TRUST ANCHOR AUTHORIZED FOR AA_BRIEFCASE_V1_1
optional_audit_commitments: PRIVATE TASK POPULATION SHA256 OR EQUIVALENT OPAQUE COMMITMENT
LOAD-BEARING CHECK POPULATION SHA256 OR EQUIVALENT OPAQUE COMMITMENT
OPUS REFERENCE SUBJECT SHA256 OR EQUIVALENT OPAQUE COMMITMENT
preferred_response_format.logical_sufficiency_boundary: THE OPTIONAL PRIVATE POPULATION COMMITMENTS IMPROVE AUDITABILITY AND REPLAY BUT ARE NOT REQUIRED FOR LOGICAL SUFFICIENCY WHEN THE BENCHMARK OWNER ITSELF AUTHENTICALLY ATTESTS THE COMPLETE-SCOPE NONINFERIORITY PROPOSITION.
preferred_response_format.privacy: NO PRIVATE TASK TEXT RUBRIC TEXT CHECK IDS PER-CHECK VERDICTS OR PRIVATE POPULATION HASHES NEED TO BE DISCLOSED FOR THE LOGICALLY MINIMAL CORE.

alternatives_if_owner_cannot_issue_scope: DETAILED SCOPE-COMPLETE E_M_U RECEIPT OVER PRIVATE CHECKS
ONE MATCHED CURRENT-EPOCH INDEPENDENT OR OWNER-VERIFIED BRAIN ELO RECEIPT
explicitly_not_requested: PRIVATE TASK/CHECK POPULATION HASHES UNLESS THE OWNER VOLUNTARILY INCLUDES THEM FOR AUDITABILITY
A SECOND AA_BRIEFCASE RUN FOR THE SECOND FAMILY ALIAS

NO CLAIM THE SERVICE OR OWNER ACTION WOULD BE FREE.

preferred_delivery_routes.instruction: SIGN THE UTF-8 CANONICAL JSON BYTES WITH SORTED KEYS AND JSON SEPARATORS COMMA/COLON USING ED25519.
preferred_delivery_routes.owner_key_requirement: THE PUBLIC KEY MUST BE AUTHENTICATED TO ARTIFICIAL ANALYSIS OR AN AUTHORIZED AA_BRIEFCASE OPERATOR AND BOUND TO AA_BRIEFCASE_V1_1.

preferred_delivery_routes.instruction: PUBLICATION IN AN OFFICIAL OWNER-CONTROLLED REPOSITORY MAY PROVIDE AN AUTHENTICATED ORIGIN ROUTE.
preferred_delivery_routes.boundary: DO NOT TREAT PUBLICATION ALONE AS CURRENTLY EXECUTABLE AA CREDIT UNTIL AN OWNER-ORIGIN PUBLICATION VERIFIER/ADAPTER IS BOUND.

preferred_delivery_routes.instruction: A SIGSTORE/COSIGN OR DSSE ATTESTATION IS ACCEPTABLE IN PRINCIPLE IF ITS OWNER IDENTITY CAN BE VERIFIED.
preferred_delivery_routes.boundary: DO NOT LABEL THIS AS CURRENTLY EXECUTABLE UNTIL A DEDICATED DSSE/SIGSTORE VERIFIER IS BOUND.
